consults.title: May consult
consults.line: It can steer this agent with its questions, and its answers may quote what it reads in tables this agent can't.
consults.inactive: Inactive: one of the two changes the workspace and the other doesn't, so they can't consult each other.
consults.kept: Turn on Whitelist to use these again.
consults.auto: Any agent of this workspace on its side
consults.autoCapped: Only the first {{max}} are offered. Pick them instead.

toolAsk.note: Disabled actions stop immediately. Re-enabled actions are available in a new CLI session.

cliRules.title: Remembered CLI permissions
cliRules.note: Removing a rule takes effect when this agent starts its next session.

data.label: Work on data
data.text: Its Jobs can read, add, change and delete rows.

configure.label: Change tables and fields
configure.text: Its Jobs can create tables, change what they are called, and add, change and order their fields. Deleting stays yours.

agent.label: Its own memory
agent.text: Its Jobs keep what they learn for its next Jobs.

data.label: Its tables' memory
data.text: Its Jobs keep what they learn about the tables they work on, for every agent working on them. Needs “Work on data”.

workspace.label: The workspace's memory
workspace.text: What it writes steers every agent of the workspace.

model.modelHint: Enter a model id or CLI alias, or leave empty for the harness default ({{model}}). Changing the harness clears the model override.
model.listFailed: Could not list models. You can enter a model below.

stem.label: Plugin changes
stem.approval: · {{assistant}} suggests a value, which waits for your Approval in the Inbox: yours stays until you accept it
stem.approvalSoon: · {{assistant}} suggests a value: its Approval reaches the Inbox once {{assistant}} is done, and yours stays until you accept it
stem.openApproval: Open the Approval in the Inbox

jobs.emptyText: Each time one of this agent's triggers fires, the Job it makes shows up here.

triggers.emptyText: A trigger makes this agent work: a chat or a button you start, or a schedule.

fire.skipped-overlap: skipped, a Job was still going

sheet.description: What makes this agent work. Each time it fires, the agent gets a Job.

schedule.label: Schedule
schedule.hint: The Job starts by itself, on a schedule.

change.label: Table change
change.hint: The Job starts when a row of a table changes, and is told the change.

poll.label: Poll
poll.hint: A tool is asked for its list every few minutes: each new item starts a Job, and the Job is told the item.

problem.name: Give the trigger a name
problem.table: Pick the table whose changes start the Job
problem.fields: Pick the fields whose change starts the Job, or Any field
problem.cap: The hour's cap is a whole number from 1 to 1000
problem.tool: Pick the tool and the action a poll reads
problem.jsonObject: The arguments are a JSON object: { … }
problem.idPath: Say where an item's id is
problem.interval: A poll runs every 1 to 1440 minutes

sheet.name: Name
sheet.instructionsHint: What the agent is asked to do each time this trigger fires.
sheet.oneAtATimePoll: A new item found while this trigger's Job is still going waits for it to end.
sheet.oneAtATimeChange: A change that comes while this trigger's Job is still going waits for it to end.
sheet.oneAtATimeSchedule: A time that comes while this trigger's Job is still going is skipped.

poll.baseline: First poll: {{found}} item(s) recorded, no Job
poll.baselineNote: First poll: {{found}} item(s) recorded, no Job ({{message}})

item.deferred: Waiting: the hour's cap is reached, or a Job is still going
item.out-of-scope: Skipped: the agent may no longer read this action

poll.toolHint: One of the agent's tools: the trigger calls it on its own, outside any Job.
poll.actionNone: No action of this tool may be read by a poll: let polls read one on the tool's page.
poll.actionHint: Only actions polls may read: read-only, and no agent asks before using them.
poll.preset: Filled in from the tool's catalog entry: change what you need.
poll.argumentsHint: {{lastPoll}} in a value stands for when the newest item was found; {{lastPollEpoch}} for that time in seconds since 1970.
poll.itemsAtHint: Where the list is in the result, keys between dots (value, data.items); empty when the result is the list.
poll.idAtHint: What identifies an item, within it (id).
poll.continuation: Pages through the result: the next page is at <0>{{path}}</0>, sent back as <1>{{argument}}</1>.
poll.capHint: Past it, new items wait their turn: none is lost.

status.deferred: Waiting: the hour's cap is reached, or a Job is still going
status.skipped-same-agent: Skipped: this agent's own Job made the change
status.stopped: Stopped: its work was declined at a checkpoint
status.out-of-scope: Skipped: the agent may not read this

change.tableNone: No table's changes are events yet: open a table's menu, Events and parent.
change.capHint: Past it, changes wait their turn: none is lost.

escalations.title: May escalate
escalations.line: It may ask these people a question outside a chat, when it needs a person's answer.
escalations.noProfile: No profile yet: agents can't tell what they know.
escalations.kept: Turn on Whitelist to use these again.
escalations.autoCapped: Only the first {{max}} are offered. Pick them instead.

preferAgents.label: Prefer to ask agents over humans
preferAgents.text: Its ask tool lists agents first and tells it to ask an agent unless none can answer.

nativePlugins.title: Native plugins
nativePlugins.detail: In a container runner, this agent's conversations run each granted plugin whole, its hooks and servers included, inside their sandbox.
nativePlugins.none: No plugin from a marketplace is installed.
nativePlugins.behind: Its latest changes wait for a manager's approval.
